name: Katral-Nada Hassan
title: Digital strategist and customer experience consultant
bio_short: Digital strategist and customer experience consultant with more than 15 years' experience across four continents. Head of Design and Experience at Alraedah Finance. Former Head of Product Experience at YAP. MBA from Hult International Business School.
bio: Katral-Nada is a digital strategist and customer experience consultant with more than 15 years' experience designing and implementing digital strategies for clients across diverse sectors and markets. She has worked in Canada, the United States, Europe and the GCC, giving her a broad international perspective on how digital channels serve business and communication objectives.  She is currently Head of Design and Experience at Alraedah Finance, a Saudi fintech company, and previously served as Head of Product Experience and Innovation at YAP, where she led the team building the region's first independent digital banking application. Earlier in her career she co-founded The Experience Agency, a digital consultancy in Dubai. She holds an MBA from Hult International Business School and was the Dubai City Leader for World IA Day 2015.  At ISOC, Katral-Nada delivers digital communications, social media, customer experience and digital strategy programmes. Her career at the intersection of technology, business and audience behaviour gives her training a distinctive angle: she helps participants understand how audiences discover, interact with and form impressions of organisations in digital environments. Her bilingual capability in English and Arabic makes her well suited to training programmes across the Gulf region. Katral-Nada is based in Dubai.
